reviewed_by: Codex focused diff review for chat history backend benchmark
reason: The diff adds a reproducible throwaway benchmark, raw receipts, and a report comparing the already merged session-indexed SQLite read with direct SQLite JSON and LMDB candidates. Three collected Python cases verify index projection and query plan, existing-database migration, and histories longer than a storage page. Benchmark smoke runs verify equal transcripts for full and 61-message page reads.
exclusions: No Core or UI production source, browser behavior, frontend, or native code changed. The benchmark measures warm local database reads and model validation; unrelated Python tests, browser projects, native tests, HTTP, rendering, write throughput, and physical devices are excluded.
